biggest_catch: Full Election Day runs 6:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. plus setup/close-down for a flat $150/day as a clerk.
catches: Flat per-day pay regardless of how long closing takes.
Must complete mandatory training before every election (paid $25-$50 per session).
Supervising judge roles ($175-$200/day) require experience/selection; most workers are clerks at $150/day.
Selection is based on need and not guaranteed — applying does not guarantee a shift.

steps: Be a Johnson County KS resident with current voter registration (18+, or 16+ with school approval).
Complete the Election Worker Application and submit Social Security card + driver's license for payroll.
Complete the mandatory training session before the election (paid $25-$50).
Report at 6:00 a.m. on Election Day; work polls 7:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. plus close-down.
timing: Election-day work (advance voting shifts also available) plus mandatory training per election.
